title: A/R Collection: a link with an unknown customer ignores it
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You open A/R Collection from a link that names a customer who does not exist.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has overdue invoices on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-35 Old Link.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-A}.
  2. In the address bar, after {Customer-A}'s code (the text after "customerIds="), add a comma and "Nobody".
  3. Press Enter.
  4. In the address bar, replace everything after "customerIds=" with "Nobody".
  5. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-A}'s name; only {Customer-A}'s group is listed; the page address carries "customerIds=" followed by {Customer-A}'s code (a long code, not the name).
  • Step 2: the address bar shows {Customer-A}'s code, a comma and "Nobody" after "customerIds=".
  • Step 3: the report loads normally, with no error; the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-A}'s name and only {Customer-A}'s group is listed: the unknown customer is ignored.
  • Step 4: the address bar shows "Nobody" after "customerIds=".
  • Step 5: the report loads normally, with no error; the chip reads "Customer: All customers" in the resting (grey) style: with no known customer left, the link opens as if none were ticked.

Why: a link saved earlier can name a customer that was since deleted or merged; the tech plan says such a link must still open the report.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R19: “The ticked customers or vendors and the ticked Past due ranges are kept in the page address like Location (S5-R10).”
  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D29: “Unknown or unresolvable customer/vendor/location ids in a link are dropped by the FE during the opening reconcile (resolve endpoint / option list) before any request, so the BE 422 is never reached from the UI”
  • Tech plan §3 D29, rationale: “Mirrors S5-N2 for customers/vendors (a deleted or merged customer in an old link must not break the report).”
  • Tech plan §3 D30: “URL keys asOfDate, customerIds / vendorIds, pastDue, locationIds (repeated keys written, comma lists also read); legacy customerId / vendorId read once as aliases.”
